raw_text: Stanford Internet Observatory — Analysis: Coordinated Inauthentic Behavior Around Doklam Imagery, June 2024. Our research team has identified a coordinated information operation recycling imagery from the 2017 Doklam standoff and presenting it as current military activity. Reverse image searches confirm that at least four of the six images circulated on Weibo and CCTV segments originate from PLA archives dated August 2017. The campaign appears designed to amplify perceptions of Chinese military dominance in the disputed tri-junction area. This pattern is consistent with previously documented Chinese cognitive warfare tactics targeting Indian domestic audiences.
